faq: 1. What services does Technexa Solutions offer?
We offer website development, digital marketing, custom software solutions, and UI/UX design all tailored for startups and growing businesses.
2. How long does a typical project take?
Most websites take 2-4 weeks, custom software solutions 4-12 weeks depending on complexity and requirements.
3. Can your services scale as our business grows?
Absolutely. Our systems are built to adapt, optimize, and scale alongside your evolving business needs.
4. Do you work with startups or only established brands?
We work with both. Our strategies are tailored to each growth stage, from emerging startups to enterprise-level organizations.
5. How long does it take to see results?
Most clients begin seeing measurable improvements within the first 30 to 60 days, depending on goals and market conditions.
